subject: ai
question: What is a semantic network? Explain with an example.
title: Canary Inherits Flying
hook: A canary can fly. Nobody told the canary.
answer: A semantic network is a graph that represents knowledge: nodes are concepts/objects, labelled arcs (links) are relations between them
Common links: IS-A (type) and HAS / CAN (properties)
Example: canary IS-A bird, bird IS-A animal; animal has skin; bird has wings, can fly; canary is yellow, can sing
Inheritance: can a canary fly? follow the IS-A link up to bird, bird can fly, so yes; facts are never stored twice
